description: This file defines a module for managing a Node.js-based service within a larger gateway framework. It includes functions to set environment variables specific to the Node service, and it exports a function that returns a GatewayService object with methods for stage, install, uninstall, stop, restart, and status checks, all augmented with node-specific environment configuration.
